items.title: Carmen Leggio interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998
items.q: You know Ragusa was right on the ball.

ctx.x: What was the family business for you as you grew up? Your parents were—

Uh, family business, it was big family and there was a number of businesses. My grandfather in Sicily, which I never met, was superintendent of the sulfur mines in Sicily, where the ball is. You know Ragusa was right on the ball. There’s the boot and then there’s the ball. They were right across from Tunisia. And most of the relatives all worked in General Motors here in Tarrytown. They worked in General Motors. Now they’re breaking it down, they’re breaking General Motors down, but this was the big thing in…
